summary: Cdecl wrapper around TextureFilterAndLayerCompositing(a2, a1, 1) that returns 0 on any non-negative result and otherwise propagates the negative result.

local_names.a1: first integer argument forwarded to the callee
local_names.a2: float pointer argument forwarded to the callee

operations.description: Calls TextureFilterAndLayerCompositing(a2, a1, 1), passing the float pointer first, the integer second, and the literal constant 1.
Branches on the callee result: when it is greater than or equal to 0, the wrapper returns 0.
When the callee result is negative, returns that negative result unmodified (treated as a propagated error/status code).

unresolved: Meaning of the constant argument 1 and the exact contract of TextureFilterAndLayerCompositing (0x005147EA) are outside this packet.
